landing.title: Maestro Documentation
landing.description: Complete documentation for Maestro commands, skills, and workflows.
landing.quick_guide_step1: Initialize a project with /maestro-init, then describe any goal to /maestro to auto-orchestrate the workflow
landing.quick_guide_step2: Use /maestro-next to advance one step at a time, or /maestro-companion for quick fixes that skip the full pipeline
landing.quick_guide_step3: /maestro runs the built-in analyze → plan → execute → verify pipeline for you — including the verification gate
landing.quick_guide_step4: Capture knowledge with /maestro-knowhow, manage the knowledge base with /maestro-knowledge, and study the codebase with /maestro-learn
